benefitRows.name: Swiggy
benefitRows.description: Upto 20% discount on partner restaurants via Swiggy Dineout.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the Swiggy or Dineout app or website using your registered account. Browse the available dining and order-in offers, select your favorite meals or restaurants, and apply the benefit at checkout to enjoy up to 20% savings at 20,000+ partner restaurants. Complete the payment using your HDFC MoneyBack credit card to unlock the offer.
